license_required.quote: No individual shall engage in the following practices unless such individual has obtained a credential under the Uniform Credentialing Act

issuing_authority.value: Division of Public Health, Department of Health and Human Services
issuing_authority.quote: the Licensure Unit of the Division of Public Health of the Department of Health and Human Services

name.value: Nebraska Board of Medicine and Surgery (via State Board of Health appointment)
name.quote: Board means one of the boards appointed by the State Board of Health pursuant to section 38-158

type.quote: The board shall consist of eight members, including at least two public members. Two of the six professional members of the board shall be officials or members of the instructional staff of an accredited medical school in this state. One of the six professional members of the board shall be a person who has a license to practice osteopathic medicine and surgery in this state.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Public Health, Department of Health and Human Services
umbrella_agency.quote: the Licensure Unit of the Division of Public Health of the Department of Health and Human Services

age_minimum.quote: No individual shall be issued a credential under the Uniform Credentialing Act until he or she has furnished satisfactory evidence to the department that he or she is of good character and has attained the age of nineteen years

moral_character_required.quote: he or she has furnished satisfactory evidence to the department that he or she is of good character

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited school or college of medicine
degree_required.quote: Present proof that he or she is a graduate of an accredited school or college of medicine

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved accreditation standards (Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates for foreign graduates)
accrediting_body.quote: if a foreign medical graduate, provide a copy of a permanent certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

required.quote: Present proof that he or she has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board

duration.value: at least one year (domestic); at least two years (foreign medical graduates)
duration.quote: has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board or, if a foreign medical graduate, present proof that he or she has served at least two years of graduate medical education approved by the board

kind.quote: graduate medical education or residency means a program of supervised educational training, approved by the board, in a medical specialty at an accredited hospital

exams.name: Licensing examination in medicine and surgery (USMLE or equivalent)
exams.notes: Applicant who fails any part within four attempts must complete one additional year of postgraduate medical education; all parts must be completed within ten years.
exams.quote: Pass a licensing examination approved by the board covering appropriate medical subjects

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX)
exams.notes: Required for expedited licensure under the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact; must pass each component within three attempts.
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination within three attempts

interval_years.quote: The credential to practice a profession shall be renewed biennially upon request of the credentialed person

required.quote: the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

hours_per_period.quote: shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

period_years.quote: at least three hours of continuing education biennially

value: risks and indicators of opiate addiction
topical_requirements.quote: education regarding prescribing and administering opiates, the risks and indicators regarding development of addiction to opiates, and emergency opiate situations. One-half hour of the three hours of continuing education shall cover the prescription drug monitoring program

available.quote: An applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery based on a license in another state or territory of the United States or the District of Columbia shall comply with the requirements of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact

requirements.value: Applicant must comply with the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact requirements or meet board-set standards; applicant licensed by state examination in another jurisdiction may be issued a license by the department with board recommendation.
requirements.quote: An applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery based on a license in another state or territory of the United States or the District of Columbia shall comply with the requirements of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact beginning on the effective date of the compact or meet the standards set by the board pursuant to section 38-126

exists.quote: The board shall consist of eight members, including at least two public members. Two of the six professional members of the board shall be officials or members of the instructional staff of an accredited medical school in this state.

national_certification.value: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG)
national_certification.quote: if a foreign medical graduate, provide a copy of a permanent certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

national_association.quote: Nothing in this section shall be construed to prohibit the department, with the recommendation of the board, from accepting accreditation of a school or college of osteopathic medicine by the American Osteopathic Association

regulatory_model.quote: No individual shall engage in the following practices unless such individual has obtained a credential under the Uniform Credentialing Act

credential_type.quote: License means an authorization issued by the department to an individual to engage in a profession or to a business to provide services which would otherwise be unlawful in this state in the absence of such authorization.

is_mandatory.quote: No individual shall engage in the following practices unless such individual has obtained a credential under the Uniform Credentialing Act

title_protection.quote: Persons who attach to their name the title of M.D., surgeon, physician, physician and surgeon, or any word or abbreviation and who indicate that they are engaged in the treatment or diagnosis of ailments, diseases, injuries, pain, deformity, infirmity, or any physical or mental condition of human beings

scope_protection.quote: Every act or practice falling within the practice of medicine and surgery as defined in section 38-2024 and not specially excepted in this section shall constitute the practice of medicine and surgery and may be performed in this state only by those licensed by law to practice medicine in Nebraska.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of material facts in procuring or attempting to procure a credential
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of material facts in procuring or attempting to procure a credential

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral or dishonorable conduct evidencing unfitness to practice the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral or dishonorable conduct evidencing unfitness to practice the profession in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abuse of, dependence on, or active addiction to alcohol, controlled substances, or mind-altering substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abuse of, dependence on, or active addiction to alcohol, any controlled substance, or any mind-altering substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with a treatment or aftercare program including the Licensee Assistance Program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with a treatment program or an aftercare program, including, but not limited to, a program entered into under the Licensee Assistance Program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor or felony with rational connection to fitness to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of (a) a misdemeanor or felony under Nebraska law or federal law, or (b) a crime in any jurisdiction which, if committed within this state, would have constituted a misdemeanor or felony under Nebraska law and which has a rational connection with the fitness or capacity of the applicant or credential holder to practice the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of the profession fraudulently, beyond authorized scope, with gross incompetence, or in a pattern of negligent conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice of the profession (a) fraudulently, (b) beyond its authorized scope, (c) with gross incompetence or gross negligence, or (d) in a pattern of incompetent or negligent conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice while ability is impaired by alcohol, drugs, or physical/mental/emotional disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice of the profession while the ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, controlled substances, drugs, mind-altering substances, physical disability, mental disability, or emotional disability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental incapacity to practice as evidenced by legal judgment or other lawful determination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental incapacity to practice the profession as evidenced by a legal judgment or a determination by other lawful means

disciplinary_grounds.description: Illness, deterioration, or disability that impairs the ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Illness, deterioration, or disability that impairs the ability to practice the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting, aiding, or abetting the practice of a profession by an uncredentialed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting, aiding, or abetting the practice of a profession or the performance of activities requiring a credential by a person not credentialed to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having had a credential denied, limited, suspended, or revoked by another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having had his or her credential denied, refused renewal, limited, suspended, revoked, or disciplined in any manner similar to section 38-196 by another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of untruthful, deceptive, or misleading statements in advertisements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of untruthful, deceptive, or misleading statements in advertisements, including failure to comply with section 38-124

disciplinary_grounds.description: Distribution of intoxicating liquors, controlled substances, or drugs for other than lawful purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Distribution of intoxicating liquors, controlled substances, or drugs for any other than lawful purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations of the Uniform Credentialing Act or applicable rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violations of the Uniform Credentialing Act or the rules and regulations relating to the particular profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawful invasion of the field of practice of any profession the credential holder is not credentialed to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unlawful invasion of the field of practice of any profession regulated by the Uniform Credentialing Act which the credential holder is not credentialed to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act or any rules and regulations adopted pursuant to the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to file a required statutory report
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to file a report required by section 38-1,124, 38-1,125, or 71-552

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain the requirements necessary to obtain a credential
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain the requirements necessary to obtain a credential

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of an order issued by the department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of an order issued by the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in section 38-179
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct as defined in section 38-179

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the Preborn Child Protection Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the Preborn Child Protection Act

definition_quote.value: Persons who publicly profess to be physicians or surgeons or publicly profess to assume the duties incident to the practice of medicine, surgery, or any of their branches; persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery; persons holding themselves out to the public as being qualified in the diagnosis or treatment of diseases, ailments, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or injuries of human beings; persons who suggest, recommend, or prescribe any form of treatment for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of any physical or mental ailment of any person; persons who maintain an office for the examination or treatment of persons afflicted with ailments, diseases, injuries, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition of human beings.
definition_quote.quote: Persons who publicly profess to be physicians or surgeons or publicly profess to assume the duties incident to the practice of medicine, surgery, or any of their branches

methods_authorized.quote: Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, administer, and furnish medicines and controlled substances for medically accepted therapeutic purposes; prescribing controlled substances to oneself or family members (except in emergencies) is unprofessional conduct.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing, administering, distributing, dispensing, giving, or selling any controlled substance or other drug recognized as addictive or dangerous for other than a medically accepted therapeutic purpose

license_status_types.quote: Inactive credential means a credential which the credential holder has voluntarily placed on inactive status

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must provide a permanent ECFMG certificate, pass the Visa Qualifying Examination or equivalent, or have completed the Fifth Pathway program; must also complete at least two years of board-approved graduate medical education (vs. one year for domestic graduates).
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: if a foreign medical graduate, provide a copy of a permanent certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates that is currently effective and relates to such applicant

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Present proof that he or she has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board

pain_management_education_required.quote: the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: One-half hour of the three hours of continuing education shall cover the prescription drug monitoring program described in sections 71-2454 to 71-2456.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians physically located in another state who, through electronic medium, perform for compensation any service constituting the healing arts that would affect the diagnosis or treatment of an individual located in Nebraska are deemed to be practicing medicine in Nebraska and must be licensed.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Persons who are physically located in another state but who, through the use of any medium, including an electronic medium, perform for compensation any service which constitutes the healing arts that would affect the diagnosis or treatment of an individual located in this state.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Physicians who are licensed in good standing to practice medicine under the laws of another state when incidentally called into this state or contacted via electronic or other medium for consultation with a physician licensed in this state.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: An applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery based on a license in another state or territory of the United States or the District of Columbia shall comply with the requirements of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact beginning on the effective date of the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: who the department, with the recommendation of the board, approves to perform medical services under a collaborative agreement with the supervision of a physician

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may perform medical services under a collaborative agreement with the supervision of a physician; specific prescriptive authority is governed by board rules under the Medicine and Surgery Practice Act.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: approves to perform medical services under a collaborative agreement with the supervision of a physician

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The department may contract to provide a Licensee Assistance Program to credential holders regulated by the department. The program shall be limited to providing education, referral assistance, and monitoring of compliance with treatment for abuse of, dependence on, or active addiction to alcohol, any controlled substance, or any mind-altering substance

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Require the applicant to submit to a complete diagnostic examination at the expense of the applicant by one or more physicians or other qualified professionals appointed by the board

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A physician locum tenens may be issued by the department, with the recommendation of the board, to an individual who holds an active license to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery in another state
